description: Every almost disjoint family of infinite subsets of the naturals is contained in a maximal almost disjoint family, in the default classical foundation admitting choice.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.maximal_extension (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) :
  ∃ M, A ⊆ M ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsMaximalAlmostDisjoint M
